query: Does the date of arrival to Singapore in the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) or entry date refers to date of embarkation from last city/port?
reference_answer: The "Date of Arrival to Singapore" in the SG Arrival Card refers to the expected arrival date or entry date to Singapore.
answer: The date of arrival in the SG Arrival Card (SGAC) does not refer to the date of embarkation from the last city/port. It typically refers to the actual date of arrival in Singapore. [Document N] not available for this information.
